title: Copilot Inventory Queries
summary: A partner-built Copilot extension for Business Central helps manufacturing companies manage inventory by answering natural language questions about reorder points, replenishment timing, and demand trends. It uses Azure OpenAI as a backend AI model with structured prompts and JSON data from inventory tables to provide suggestions with explanations.
key_points: The extension uses Microsoft's Copilot interface tools in AL to build custom AI features for inventory management
It connects to an Azure OpenAI deployment configured in Azure AI Foundry with credentials stored securely in isolated storage
Prompts include system instructions that teach the AI model to analyze Business Central inventory data (item ledger entries, open orders) and answer user questions
The solution optimizes costs by compressing data before sending to the AI model and only including relevant fields
It demonstrates practical AI use cases like suggesting reorder points, reorder quantities, sales trends, and reordering policies

quotes.text: The Copilot features and the underlying AI capabilities are what get people talking when we present Business Central to customers.
quotes.why_it_matters: It illustrates why Copilot is a key sales driver and customer interest point for Business Central in competitive positioning

quotes.text: It is surprisingly simple to create, you need to learn the Copilot interface features that Microsoft provides
quotes.why_it_matters: It shows that building custom Copilot features is accessible to partners when they understand the available tools and interfaces
